description: Authorized business calls shared by Git and PF. Query deliberately; default receipts remain concise. See docs/business-ledger.md.

columns.operation_ref: TEXT PRIMARY KEY. Stable random reference across restored routes.
columns.operation_seq: INTEGER. Operation admission order on the retained route.
columns.actor: TEXT. Role bound by the host listener.
columns.initiator: TEXT. model, registered_script, or host; bound by the host.
columns.tool: TEXT. Authorized business tool or next_week.
columns.parameters_json: TEXT. Complete public request parameters as JSON.
columns.outcome: TEXT. unfinished, succeeded, rejected, partial, or unknown. Unfinished does not imply zero effects or a live worker.
columns.result_json: TEXT. Complete tool result including per-item failures, or canonical next_week terminal outcome; NULL until confirmed.
